Devon / Alyssa —

Thank you for your patience. Quick summary and next steps (P0):

What happened:
- A scheduled project-tier migration ran at 07:30 PDT. medcare-prod was included due to a tagging mismatch on the migration job. The new mapping reduced per-project burst allowances, which caused sudden 429s under MedCare's normal traffic profile and triggered a retry amplification loop.

What we did (completed by 09:15):
- Rolled medcare-prod back to the previous project tier mapping (Rishi).
- Temporarily increased burst quota for medcare-prod and applied per-key bypass for critical API keys.
- SRE applied a short-term retry dampening policy on the ingestion endpoints to stop the retry storm (Sean).

Next actions (owner / ETA):
- Short-term verification: joint smoke test with MedCare ops in 30 minutes (Marissa / Devon).
- Postmortem + tagging fix: infra will land a pre-cutover tagging validation and a dry-run check (Rishi) — ETA 72 hours.
- Account remediation: we'll issue a service credit and expedite a follow-up architecture review with your team (Kimberly) — I will send a MAP (mutual-action-plan.docx) and the proposed credit within 24 hours.

We're escalating this internally to ensure the tagging rules and migration dry-run are hardened. I'll set up a short executive sync if you'd like us to join.

Apologies again for the impact. We'll keep tight updates until your traffic stabilizes.

-Kim
